items.source: BeanFactoryPostProcessor that ensures that the AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect aspect is up and running before the EntityManagerFactory gets created as this already instantiates entity listeners and we need to get injection into Configurable to work in them.
items.translation: 一个BeanFactoryPostProcessor，用于确保在EntityManagerFactory创建之前，AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect切面已经正常运行。这是因为EntityManagerFactory的创建会立即实例化实体监听器，而我们需要在它们中实现向Configurable的注入才能正常工作。

items.source: Implementation classes for auditing with JPA.
items.translation: 使用 JPA 实现审计类的类。

items.source: JPA specific support classes to implement domain classes.
items.translation: 用于实现领域类的 JPA 特定支持类。

items.source: JPA entity listener to capture auditing information on persisting and updating entities.
items.translation: 用于在持久化和更新实体时捕获审计信息的 JPA 实体监听器。
